text: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation became a wholly owned subsidiary of Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group when SMFG was established in December 2002 as a bank holding company through a share transfer.
short: SMBC is wholly owned by Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group.

source.name: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group: Annual Report FY2023, Group Companies (PDF)
source.quote: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. was established in December 2002 as a bank holding company through a share transfer, and SMBC became a wholly owned subsidiary of Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group.
source.note: SMFG's own English annual report (FY2023, published 2024), Group Companies section.
